narrative:
Highland County has 27,072 registered voters, with 12.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 35.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.5%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 14.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.8% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -13.2% D−R vs -33.4% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
